sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Providing retrieved evidence to a model before it generates an answer.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: An open-book answer can consult a passage instead of relying only on memory.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A model receives authorized Joule Studio passages before drafting an explanation.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Knowledge OS supplies retrieval and evidence contracts; a consuming agent or model produces the answer.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Retrieval makes relevant source context available, but cannot guarantee a correct generated answer.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Do not confuse retrieval traces with execution of an answer-generation service in this repository.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
